text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off from training, I casually 
peeked over at the track—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... I-I can't go on any 
longer...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...No, Rice has to try harder. Because 
Rice wants to win races...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Rice, hang in there~! 
Alright, one more lap...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait... huh? Isn't that over there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... I-It is impossible to run 
any further desu wa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...There is nothing left to do but give up 
desu wa...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No, you can't!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Rice-san...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, follow behind... follow 
behind Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wanted to win races so badly, so Rice 
pushed forward telling herself she'd 
definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When you have a goal, you see, it brings 
out strength you never even knew you had.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It lets you work so hard it even surprises 
yourself, so please...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Make Rice your goal and run for now...! 
Don't give up, let's keep fighting...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: N-No... that is not quite what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... The truth is, lately, well... how 
should I say, my body has felt quite 
heavy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
M-My weight has increased, so I was merely 
thinking of giving up on sweets...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: E-Eeehh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I apologize deeply for the 
misunderstanding. Please keep this... 
strictly between us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, what you just said, Rice-san, has 
truly opened my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Having a goal gives strength, allowing one 
to push forward to an astonishing 
degree...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I shall muster all my strength 
for the sake of sweets! Rice-san, let us 
run desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... yeah! Rice will do her best for 
McQueen-san's goal!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Alright McQueen-san, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, let us go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Rice suddenly feels completely out 
of energy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I shall become the goal! 
Come, follow after me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeh~... Rice is following, Rice is 
following...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having a goal gives you the strength to 
push forward— no matter what it is, having 
a destination is crucial.
